name.zh: 硬摇滚、前卫与早期金属

summary.en: Side-long suites and crushed riffs share the same decade of bigger rooms.
summary.zh: 边长组曲与压扁的 Riff，共享体育馆变大的同一个十年。

sound.en: Concept side-longs, downtuned power chords, double-kick and tom fills
sound.zh: 概念专集长曲、降调强力和弦、双踩与通通鼓填充

body.en:
The seventies split into parallel markets. Prog uses odd meters, Mellotron, and multi-part suites. Hard rock bets on riff, volume, and chorus hooks. Led Zeppelin mixes acoustic/electric dynamics and long improvisation. Black Sabbath detunes and writes tritone-heavy songs that seed metal. Pink Floyd builds album-length studio concepts. King Crimson keeps dissonant structure tight.

Arena touring scales with PA systems and lighting rigs. Bigger songs need bigger rooms; the economics follow.
body.zh:
七十年代分裂成并行市场。Prog 用怪拍子、Mellotron 与多段组曲。Hard Rock 押注 Riff、音量与副歌钩子。Led Zeppelin 混合原声/电声动态与长即兴。Black Sabbath 降调，写三全音偏重的曲子，给金属定调。Pink Floyd 做专辑尺度的录音室概念专集。King Crimson 把不协和结构收得很紧。

体育馆巡演随 PA 与灯光架放大。歌更大，场地更大；经济模型跟着走。
